name: Cobblestone Path
desc1: This short pathway appears to be made of cobblestone, small rocks
desc2: fitted together to form a relatively smooth roadway. But to your
desc3: horror, looking closely you discover you are standing on the tops of
desc4: hundreds of skulls! Some are human, some are demi-human, but all have
desc5: been cleaned and polished with great care, gleaming sickly in the
desc6: darkness. The road leads to the south, where you can see a large
desc7: castle, looming ominously, or to the north back to town.
